mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_comment (post_id, user_id, content, parent_id, reply_to_user_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{replyToUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT fc.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatar_url, ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname FROM forum_comment fc LEFT JOIN user u ON fc.user_id = u.username LEFT JOIN user ru ON fc.reply_to_user_id = ru.username WHERE fc.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY fc.created_at ASC

SELECT fc.*, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar_url AS avatar_url, ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname FROM forum_comment fc LEFT JOIN user u ON fc.user_id = u.username LEFT JOIN user ru ON fc.reply_to_user_id = ru.username WHERE fc.post_id = #{postId} AND fc.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY fc.created_at ASC
